Decision access changes from Objects to the originating contextual detail; result loading changes to selected test/result while overview stays lazy. Each migrated assertion requires a recorded continuity assessment.

No performance or accessibility assertions are relaxed.

WB-009 remains unfinished. The session correction withdrawing earlier WB-006 through WB-008 review/TDD claims remains applicable; this decision does not restore those claims.
